issues.description: Method mismatch: the Client method 'assembleBookstore' is defined differently across artifacts. The problem statement and template expect a parameterless function 'assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore' (problem_statement.md lines 31-38; template Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift commented stub at lines 16-18). In the solution (Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift line 31) the method is implemented as 'private static func assembleBookstore(seed: Double) -> Bookstore', but Client.main() in the solution calls 'assembleBookstore()' with no arguments (Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift line 5). This parameter-list mismatch will cause a compilation error and confuses students about the required function signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembleBookstore signature consistent. Preferred: change the solution to implement a parameterless function matching the exercise, i.e. 'private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore', so Client.main() can call it without arguments. Alternatively, if a seed parameter is intended, update the problem statement and template to require 'seed: Double' and update all call sites, or give the seed a default value (e.g. 'seed: Double = 0.0') so the existing call remains valid.
